C25 and C06 share nearly identical machinery, but C16 is closest in combining income-tax returns with inspection by a federal commission or board.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"income tax returns made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 shall be open to inspection by the Renegotiation Board","parent_excerpt":"corporation income tax returns made for the year 1953 and subsequent years shall be open to inspection by the Federal Trade Commission","explanation":"Both use the same operative authorization structure for federal-agency inspection of income tax returns."},{"child_excerpt":"Such inspection shall be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Acting Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision ... approved by me this date","parent_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision ... approved by me this date","explanation":"This is distinctive, closely matching administrative machinery tied to a contemporaneously approved Treasury decision."},{"child_excerpt":"This Executive order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","explanation":"The closing effectiveness provision is nearly verbatim, reinforcing the broader operative parallel."}]}
